flora: Trunk-flower (flower-like reproductive structures emerging directly from the wood)
Stiff pinnate frond (thick, leathery leaflets arranged like a feather)
Squat armor-plated stem (short trunk covered in persistent leaf bases)
Seed-bearing receptacle (central, dome-like structure inside the open blossom)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded, stylized features; look for a clear distinction between the woody, scarred stem and the soft-touch, petal-like structures of the reproductive organs; no modern petal textures.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a detailed close-up of a complex flower-like structure with robust, thick petals; Top-Right: a segment of a stiff, parallel-veined frond; Bottom-Left: a macro view of the scarred, bumpy trunk surface; Bottom-Right: a cross-section of the seed dome.
visual_logic.ground: Pale limestone silt, offering a crisp, high-contrast surface to highlight the botanical details.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key diffused daylight, illuminating the internal structures of the trunk-blossom evenly.
